content: Timefold 1.16.0 CompositeMove.buildMove(Move...) composes N Move instances into one atomic Move; doMoveOnGenuineVariables calls each submove's doMoveOnly in order, triggering variable listeners between them so later moves can see earlier shadow-variable state. isMoveDoable returns true if ANY submove is doable (not all) — must be handled explicitly if all-or-nothing semantics are required.
